description:
Complete the parent-model side of progress visibility and goal completion without polling, synchronous waiting, structured child terminal results, or dynamic prompt cache churn.

## Background

Per-child terminal packets already wake the parent safely via follow-up delivery, and child settlement already means fully idle. What is missing is explicit group-level framing: the parent can end a turn while work runs, but must not present the goal as complete; when the final child settles, the next turn should clearly begin at an adjudication boundary rather than merely showing `Still running: none`.

## Fleet snapshots

- Real lifecycle packets continue to include still-active children, using trusted bounded activity snapshots.
- Snapshot fields distinguish pending/running/waiting/settling.
- Spawn children remain excluded from orchestrated group snapshots and packets.
- No progress-only event or timer may enqueue a model-visible message.

## Static orchestration invariant

Runtime orchestration state is event-driven and lifecycle evidence is authoritative. Keep a concise static conditional invariant in the normal `orchestrate` prompt guidance:

- after registering background work, treat delegated work as live until terminal lifecycle evidence, explicit inspection, or halt proves otherwise
- the parent may end the current turn, inspect, message, halt, or continue safe non-overlapping work
- the parent must not represent delegated work or the orchestration goal as complete while children remain live

Do not dynamically add/remove system-prompt text based on fleet state or include a changing group id in the system prompt. Dynamic prompt mutation creates provider-cache churn and cannot remain current across Pi queued follow-up continuations because Pi freezes the system-prompt override for the enclosing agent run. Remove the live-group dynamic prompt controller, runtime tool re-registration, and `before_agent_start` state projection rather than retaining a best-effort signal that can contradict authoritative lifecycle packets.

Lifecycle packets, orchestrate/halt results, and `list_minions`/`show_minion` are the runtime truth channels. Keep the static copy small and avoid duplicating the full minions skill or Beadwork appendix.

## Group-idle transition

- When processing terminal lifecycle events, detect the transition from a group with active members to no active members.
- The real coalesced lifecycle packet explicitly says the group is idle and ready for parent adjudication.
- Idle is not success, acceptance, ticket closure, or goal completion.
- Emit at most one idle indication for a given active→idle transition; later terminal reprocessing/re-renders do not create another wake.
- A group that never accepted a child does not emit idle.
- New work added to the same open group re-arms the next active→idle transition.

## Explicit non-goals

- No `await_group`, poll loop, progress heartbeat, completion token, or child result schema.
- Do not block normal parent turn completion.
- Do not inject progress snapshots every turn or use synthetic user messages.
- Do not dynamically mutate the system prompt, tool prompt guidelines, or provider payload from fleet state.
- Do not infer domain acceptance or parse Beadwork state.
- Do not change follow-up packet delivery or fully-idle child settlement semantics.

## Acceptance behavior

- The cache-stable static conditional invariant is present whenever `orchestrate` is active; it does not claim current liveness or name a current group.
- Runtime liveness changes are communicated only by real registration/tool results, lifecycle packets, explicit inspection, or halt results.
- Parent turns receive no periodic progress wake or state-driven prompt rebuild.
- Near-simultaneous final settlements coalesce into one packet with one group-idle indication.
- A child question keeps the group active and never claims idle/settled.
- Parent mail accepted before settlement continues to defer settlement; group idle appears only after true terminal commit.
- Adding a new child after idle re-arms a later idle transition.
- Final packet tells the parent to inspect evidence and decide the next action; it does not say completed/succeeded.

## Tests and validation

Add deterministic regressions for cache-stable static guidance, absence of runtime prompt re-registration/state projection, no-progress-wake, coalesced final settlement, idle epoch re-arm, parentMessage, mail-vs-settle, spawn exclusion, and session replacement. Remove tests that assert dynamic live/idle system-prompt mutation. Run pi-minions lint/test/typecheck/build, cross-package in-process Beadwork tests, and root quality gates. Commit atomically with this issue id.

Independent review of 9618819: NEEDS_FIXES. Blocking: (1) before_agent_start is bypassed by Pi 0.84.3 followUp/_runAgentPrompt lifecycle turns, so a packet-triggered turn can lack the live-group invariant; need source-verified system-prompt path for every real parent turn without synthetic user/progress wake. (2) dispatcher dedupe is batch-local; repeated/stale terminal events cause extra wakes and can consume a re-armed idle epoch. Must durably identify terminal delivery/epoch membership and suppress duplicates. (3) still-active fleet fields/count are unbounded (e.g. 10k description yields 10k packet). Bound descriptions/snapshots deterministically. (4) idle is consumed before packet submission; failed submission can lose the adjudication indication. Preserve existing delivery semantics while ensuring idle acknowledgment/consumption occurs only once delivery is accepted or is safely retryable. Reviewer evidence: scoped gates green but adversarial probes failed. Ticket remains open; fix + re-review required.

Closure re-review of 6ab1c5e remains NEEDS_FIXES. New blockers: (1) Pi 0.84.3 freezes `_systemPromptOverride` for an active run/queued continuation, so dynamic tool-guideline refresh cannot make live→idle or idle→live follow-up provider turns current. Reviewer found no supported extension-only per-followup system-prompt hook; fully correct behavior requires upstream Pi dynamic prompt-provider support, or explicit acceptance relaxation to a static conditional invariant / agent-run-boundary semantics. Do not add timing hacks. (2) mutable childId→epoch identity fails on child-ID reuse; add immutable lifecycle/registration identity carried by node/event/group ownership. (3) aggregate packet content/details can exceed 80KB; enforce deterministic aggregate UTF-8 budgets (<10KB target), ANSI/control sanitization, honest omission counts. (4) failed submission transactionally preserves terminal+idle but destructively loses drained parent mail/overlap evidence; use peek+ack at accepted-submit boundary. Root/scoped gates are green but adversarial runtime probes fail these contracts. Ticket remains open.

Independent re-review of fb38351: NEEDS_FIXES; all findings dispositioned as blocking fixes. A: reload-local lifecycle counter repeats under Jiti moduleCache:false; terminal/stale child mail and path tools retain mutation authority; parent mail omits captured epoch; overlap records lack lifecycle ownership; public 32-bit ID collision can overwrite tree nodes. Required: reload-safe opaque UUID lifecycle identity, exact live registration+epoch+nonterminal checks for every child tool/mutation, identity-bearing mail/overlap, revoke/clear authority at accepted terminal, add-if-absent tree registration and bounded collision retry. B: aggregate budget works for valid states (<9.8KB) but hostile unknown taskType crashes nudge lookup; normalize/fallback defensively. C: submit transaction passes, but failed evidence followed by explicit group halt/close becomes unreachable and leaks mailbox/overlap capacity. Required: extension-level discardGroup cancellation coordinator wired into halt (discard != ack), bounded inspection history, remove lifecycle ownership after accepted terminal. Dynamic prompt blocker remains separately unresolved. Root/scoped gates green but runtime probes fail acceptance.

Independent closure re-review of 0f82b94: PASS for every extension-local blocker from fb38351. A1 reload-safe lifecycle UUID identity; A2 exact stale-authority rejection across terminal/close/reload/replacement; A3 captured lifecycle+epoch mail/overlap ownership and exact accepted-submit cleanup; A4 add-if-absent tree registration with bounded 32-attempt collision handling. B hostile aggregate remains total, sanitized, deterministic, and below 9.8KB (probe: content 8,471 bytes; details 9,782). C all production close paths use the cancellation coordinator; failed-submit cancellation discards exact group evidence/authority without ack, history is bounded while pending evidence survives, and duplicate terminals remain suppressed. Validation: minions 344 tests; Beadwork 267 tests plus focused 5; root lint/typecheck and 2,375 tests; archive build; diff check; clean exact HEAD. No extension-local fixes remain. Separate unresolved blocker: Pi 0.84.3 freezes the system prompt for queued follow-up turns, so the original every-parent-turn dynamic live-group invariant cannot be met extension-only. Ticket remains open pending explicit acceptance decision: upstream Pi support or relaxed static/agent-run-boundary semantics.

comments.text: Decision lock (user-approved): runtime orchestration state remains event-driven. Lifecycle registration/results, terminal/state-change packets, explicit inspection, and halt are authoritative. Replace the dynamic live-group system-prompt projection with a cache-stable static conditional invariant. Do not dynamically add/remove prompt text, include group identity in the prompt, rewrite provider payloads, or retain best-effort dynamic state. Rationale: state-driven prompt mutations can invalidate provider prompt caches and Pi queued follow-ups reuse a frozen systemPromptOverride, so dynamic text can be stale or contradictory. Issue description and acceptance are updated; this supersedes the original every-parent-turn live-state injection requirement.
